methods.description: Hold each first-stage result in turn and pair it with every permitted next result, preserving recorded order. Enumerate and select complete ordered sequences, retaining allowed repeated values.

For two stages, place results in specified row and column positions and read/write ordered pairs in every permitted cell. Count cells and select rows, columns or cells satisfying the required result, and relate cells to tree paths.

Give each permitted stage result a branch and extend every existing path by all permitted next-stage results. Read complete ordered paths, extend to a third stage, count paths and select the requested complete sequences.

Exclude reuse of the same physical object, not every matching label. In an identity array bar only the same-object diagonal; in a tree remove the drawn object on that branch. Distinct remaining objects can show the same value.
